gloss: with all one's might; to one's heart's content

definitions.gloss: with all one's might; as hard as possible
definitions.explanation: doing something with maximum effort or force
doing something fully without holding back

examples.english: I shouted with all my might.

examples.english: I threw the ball as hard as I could.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}い{切|き}り⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoyed myself to my heart's content.

examples.english: On my day off, I want to sleep as much as I like.

notes:
USAGE:
Modifies physical actions (with full force) and experiences (without holding back).

FORMS:
- ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧っきり - the emphatic colloquial form, very common in speech
- As a noun: {思|おも}い{切|き}りがいい / ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ - to be decisive / indecisive

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}い{切|き}り⟦{遊|あそ}ぶ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧ - to play to one's heart's content
- {思|おも}い{切|き}り⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ - to laugh heartily
- {思|おも}い{切|き}り⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ - to run with all one's might
- {思|おも}い{切|き}り⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ - to cry one's heart out

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{切|き}る→思い切る：04590_omoikiru⟧ (verb) - to make up one's mind; to give up
